gap.prompt: The report needs ___ before it can be sent.
He is used to ___ under pressure.
gap.explain: After be used to, use the -ing form.

gap.prompt: The sooner we start, ___ it will be.
gap.explain: Use the + comparative in this structure.

gap.prompt: She is thought ___ abroad last year.
gap.explain: Use perfect infinitive for an earlier action.

gap.prompt: The decision was made ___ the new data.
gap.explain: Use on the basis of + noun.

gap.prompt: No sooner ___ the meeting than the power went out.
The company is committed to ___ waste.
gap.explain: After committed to, use the -ing form.

gap.prompt: He must ___ the deadline; the report is ready.
gap.explain: Use must have + participle for a past conclusion.

mistake.sentence: The furniture in the office are very old.
She is responsible for manage the team.
The problem was difficult to be solved.
mistake.explain: Use to solve after a difficult noun.

mistake.sentence: He suggested that she takes a break.
mistake.explain: Use the base form after suggest that.

mistake.sentence: I would rather you don’t tell anyone.
mistake.explain: Use didn’t tell after would rather you.

mistake.sentence: The number of problems have decreased significantly.

phrase.prompt: We need to ___ up with rising costs.
phrase.explain: Keep up with means stay level with changes.

phrase.prompt: The team decided to ___ back the release date.
She managed to ___ through a difficult period.
phrase.explain: Pull through means survive a difficult situation.

phrase.prompt: They want to ___ down the old warehouse.
phrase.explain: Knock down means destroy a building.

phrase.prompt: The manager asked him to ___ up for his mistake.
phrase.explain: Make up for means compensate for.

phrase.prompt: We should ___ out all possible risks before launching.
phrase.explain: Rule out means decide something is impossible.

formation.explain: Use the noun form of efficient.

formation.prompt: His behaviour at the meeting was highly ___. (PROFESSION)
formation.explain: Add un- and -al for not professional.

formation.prompt: The data provided a clear ___ for the decision. (JUSTIFY)
formation.explain: Use the noun form of justify.

formation.prompt: The instructions were ___ and easy to follow. (ACCESS)

dictation.sentence: The report needs revising before it can be sent.
The sooner we start, the easier it will be.
No sooner had we started the meeting than the power went out.
The company is committed to reducing waste.
The team decided to push back the release date.
We should rule out all possible risks before launching.
